name: Gabe Evans
bio: a Representative from Colorado; born in Aurora, Colo., July 28, 1986; home schooled; B.A., Patrick Henry College, Purcellville, Virginia, 2009; attending Colorado State University, Fort Collins, Colo.; Virginia Army National Guard, 2007-2009; United States Army, 2009-2019; Colorado Army National Guard, 2009-2019; police officer; farmer; member of the Colorado state general assembly, 2023-2025; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
